description: React component for rendering PDF previews with lazy loading and viewport detection, used in Mattermost web application.

classes.name: PDFPreview
classes.description: React component class for displaying a PDF document preview with lazy rendering and scroll handling.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Triggers download of the PDF file.

methods.name: isInViewport
methods.description: Checks if a page element is within the current viewport.

methods.name: renderPDFPage
methods.description: Renders a specific page of the PDF onto a canvas if in viewport or initial pages.

methods.name: getPdfDocument
methods.description: Loads the PDF document from URL using pdfjsLib.

methods.name: onDocumentLoad
methods.description: Handles successful PDF document load, initializes page canvases.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of the PDF document.
